rationale: The description identifies a conventional planning and design information system with shared databases and tracking of loop pairs and cables, without an affirmative AI/ML signal.
evidence_spans: A mini computer based information system developed by BCR to support the planning and design engineers in Customer Services. LEIS is a closely knit package of planning design and economic study modules that work through common databases to eliminate redundancy. Keeps track of loop pairs and cables for the engineers.
